#!/bin/bash
# NodeJS App Installation Script

apt-get update
apt-get install -y git curl jq file tar unzip tesseract-ocr tesseract-ocr-eng

cd /mnt/server

if [ -n "${GIT_ADDRESS}" ]; then
    if [ -z "${GIT_USERNAME}" ] && [ -z "${GIT_ACCESS_TOKEN}" ]; then
        git clone ${GIT_ADDRESS} .
    else
        GIT_ADDRESS_CLEAN=$(echo -e ${GIT_ADDRESS} | cut -d/ -f3-)
        git clone https://${GIT_USERNAME}:${GIT_ACCESS_TOKEN}@${GIT_ADDRESS_CLEAN} .
    fi
    if [ -n "${GIT_BRANCH}" ]; then
        git checkout ${GIT_BRANCH}
    fi
fi

if [ -f /mnt/server/package.json ]; then
    /usr/local/bin/npm install --production
fi

echo "Installation complete!"
